purpose: Legacy single-App blueprint retained only as a migration marker. Production ANPOS deployments must separate the customer-facing Marketplace GitHub App, customer Repository Supervisor GitHub App, and private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
reason: Marketplace Community audit must stay narrow single-file read, Repository Supervisor requires customer-authorized repository read/write permissions, and vendor private-template delivery is a private vendor trust role. Combining these collapses least-privilege boundaries.
migration_rule: Do not configure legacy GITHUB_APP_ID/GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY. Configure distinct GITHUB_MARKETPLACE_APP_*, GITHUB_SUPERVISOR_*, and GITHUB_VENDOR_APP_* identities and verify runtime readiness/role separation.
security_requirements: Marketplace, Repository Supervisor, and Vendor App IDs must be distinct.
Marketplace OAuth client credentials must not be reused by the Repository Supervisor App.
Vendor private keys must not be reused by another trust role.
Marketplace App must remain limited to the Community audit permission boundary.
Repository Supervisor App must not receive Administration permission.
Vendor template Administration permission must never be granted to customer-facing Marketplace or Repository Supervisor Apps.
This deprecated file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
